params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal 3D render, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows), matte dark materials with thin brass edge accents, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, thin haze, golden dust in the light, shallow depth of field. The upper 50% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography.
